message.content:
Pantone’s most commonly referenced “sky blue” is **Pantone 290 C** (the “C” stands for coated paper).  
If you’re looking for a slightly deeper sky‑blue, Pantone 2905 C is often used.  

Both are part of the standard Pantone Matching System (PMS) and are widely accepted in print and design work.
